description: Submit and inspect media transcription and analysis jobs with Speak AI.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Speak AI API key used to obtain short-lived access tokens. Generate or manage keys at https://app.speakai.co/developers/apikeys.

actions.name: get_media_insights
actions.description: Retrieve AI-generated summaries, topics, sentiment, and other insights for processed Speak AI media.

mediaId.description: The unique Speak AI media identifier.

inputSchema.description: The Speak AI media item to retrieve.

insights.description: A provider-defined object returned by Speak AI.

outputSchema.description: The analysis response returned by Speak AI.

actions.name: get_media_status
actions.description: Get processing state and metadata for one Speak AI media item.

mediaId.description: The unique Speak AI media identifier.

inputSchema.description: The Speak AI media item to retrieve.

media.description: A provider-defined object returned by Speak AI.

outputSchema.description: The processing status returned by Speak AI.

actions.name: get_transcript
actions.description: Retrieve the transcript, speakers, and timestamps for one Speak AI media item.

mediaId.description: The unique Speak AI media identifier.

inputSchema.description: The Speak AI media item to retrieve.

transcript.description: A provider-defined object returned by Speak AI.

outputSchema.description: The transcript response returned by Speak AI.

actions.name: list_folders
actions.description: List folders available in the connected Speak AI workspace.

pageSize.description: The number of folders to return.

sortBy.description: The upstream sort expression, such as createdAt:desc.

inputSchema.description: Pagination and sorting for Speak AI folders.

items.description: A provider-defined object returned by Speak AI.

folders.description: The folders returned for this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of Speak AI folders.

actions.name: list_media
actions.description: List and filter media items in the connected Speak AI workspace.

page.description: The one-based page number to return.

pageSize.description: The number of media items to return.

sortBy.description: The upstream sort expression, such as createdAt:desc.

filterMedia.description: The ownership filter: 0 for uploaded, 1 for assigned, or 2 for both.

filterName.description: Text matched against media names and analyzed content.

folderId.description: The folder whose media items should be returned.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for the Speak AI media library.

totalCount.description: The total number of matching media items.

pages.description: The number of available result pages.

items.description: A provider-defined object returned by Speak AI.

media.description: The media items returned for this page.

outputSchema.description: A page of Speak AI media items.

actions.name: upload_media
actions.description: Submit a public audio or video URL to Speak AI for asynchronous transcription and analysis.

name.description: The display name for the media item.

mediaUrl.description: A public audio, video, or supported social-media URL that Speak AI can fetch.

mediaType.description: The media type when it is known; omit it to let Speak AI inspect the URL.

description.description: A description stored with the media item.

sourceLanguage.description: The transcription language as a BCP-47 language code, such as en-US.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags stored with the media item.

folderId.description: The Speak AI folder identifier that should contain the media item.

inputSchema.description: The public media URL and metadata to submit to Speak AI.

mediaId.description: The media identifier used to poll processing and retrieve results.

outputSchema.description: The accepted Speak AI media upload.
